title: Adélie penguin body mass
adaptation_note: Descriptive within-species association; sex, island, and year are omitted.
preprocessing_summary: From 152 Adélie source rows, retain complete finite flipper length and body mass values; remove 1 incomplete row, retain 151 rows, and apply no unit conversion.

title: 28-day concrete compressive strength
adaptation_note: Educational additive plane at fixed age 28 days; the published engineering relationship is nonlinear and uses more ingredients.
preprocessing_summary: Verify and extract Concrete_Data.xls, retain rows with age exactly 28 days, and map cement, water, and compressive strength; retain 425 rows with kg/m³ and MPa unchanged.

title: Adélie penguin sex from morphology
adaptation_note: Full-data pedagogical fit of a paper-supported two-predictor model; the paper used splitting and model averaging.
preprocessing_summary: From 152 Adélie source rows, retain finite culmen length and body mass with Sex equal to FEMALE or MALE, sort by Sample Number, and encode FEMALE = 1 and MALE = 0; retain 146 rows (73/73).

title: Adélie penguin sex from bill length
adaptation_note: Simple 2D logistic regression of sex on bill length.
preprocessing_summary: From 152 Adélie source rows, retain finite culmen length with Sex equal to FEMALE or MALE, sort by Sample Number, and encode FEMALE = 1 and MALE = 0; retain 146 rows.

title: Abalone shell-ring count
adaptation_note: Associative Poisson mean model with moderate underdispersion and correlated size predictors.
preprocessing_summary: Retain all 4,177 source rows, convert normalized Length and Shell_weight by ×200 to millimetres and grams, and keep integer Rings unchanged.

title: Positive forest-fire burned area
adaptation_note: Conditional severity model after excluding 247 zero-area records; not an occurrence model.
preprocessing_summary: From 517 source rows, retain area > 0, remove 247 zero-area rows, and retain 270 rows; temperature (°C), relative humidity (%), and area (ha) remain unchanged.

title: Inner London examination achievement
adaptation_note: Two-continuous-predictor teaching specification of a richer published multilevel analysis.
preprocessing_summary: Verify and extract Exam.rda, retain all 4,059 rows, order and factor school into 65 levels, and map standLRT, schavg, and normexam; apply no unit conversion.
